Edge Steaks and Seafood is open on Ridgewood Ave, with the ribbon cut on 23 November 2026.

See the lunch menu Message us on Facebook

A new room on Ridgewood Ave

Edge ran a soft opening through early November 2026, training the team in live service week by week. On Monday 23 November 2026 the doors opened for real, with a grand opening and ribbon cutting on S. Ridgewood Ave.

The restaurant comes from Melissa Dessoye and Scott Durham, the team behind AM Café in Edgewater and New Smyrna Beach. About 3,900 people already follow the page on Facebook, where every menu and update has lived until now.

    It starts on the flame.

    Every steak at Edge is cut in house and cooked over an open flame. Keep scrolling and watch this one cook.

    The crust builds.

    Heat, smoke and patience. The outside chars dark while the centre stays pink.

    Rested. Sliced. Served.

    Off the flame, rested, and cut thick on the board. That is the whole method, and it is enough.

    On the flameSearedRested

    Six cuts, cut in house

    The steak board at Edge, cooked over open flame.

    The board

    Pick your cut

    Six house cuts, one fire. The rail moves as you scroll, the same way a board moves down a table.

    Cut one

    Sirloin

    Lean and beefy, the steakhouse staple that never leaves the board.

    Cut two

    Ribeye

    Rich marbling through the middle, the juiciest cut on the board.

    Cut three

    Strip

    A firm bite and deep beef flavor, with a proper charred edge.

    Cut four

    Filet

    The tenderest cut of the six, cut thick and cooked gently.

    Cut five

    Porterhouse

    Strip on one side of the bone, filet on the other. Built for two.

    Cut six

    Hanger

    The butcher's cut. Loose grained, dark, and full of flavor.

    The lunch menu

    The full lunch menu, as published by the restaurant on its Facebook page on 9 November 2026. A dinner menu runs in the evening, and hours and updates are shared on the Facebook page.

    Starters

    • Fried Green Tomatoes

      Cornmeal crust with remoulade. A Southern start to the meal.

    • Elote Crab Dip

      Sweet corn and crab with warm spices, chips for dipping.

    • Crispy Brussels

      Fried crisp and tossed in a sweet and salty glaze.

    • Pig Wings

      Pork shanks, glazed and charred at the edges.

    • House Chicken Wings

      Crisp wings, sauced the house way.

    Handhelds

    • Market Catch Sandwich

      The catch of the day on a toasted roll with slaw.

    • Shrimp Po' Boy

      Fried shrimp, lettuce, tomato and remoulade on French bread.

    • Fish Reuben

      Fish with sauerkraut, Swiss and Thousand Island on rye.

    • Philly Cheesesteak

      Shaved steak, peppers, onions and melted cheese on a hoagie.

    • Steakhouse Smash Burger

      Smashed patties with American cheese, pickles and house sauce.

    • Fried Chicken Sliders

      Crisp chicken and pickles on soft slider buns.

    • Grilled Chicken Wrap

      Grilled chicken, greens and tomato in a warm wrap.

    Lunch Plates

    • Fish & Chips

      Battered fish with fries and tartar sauce.

    • Shrimp & Chips

      Fried shrimp with fries and cocktail sauce.

    • Steak Frites

      Grilled steak with crisp fries and garlic butter.

    Soup

    • French Onion Soup

      Caramelized onions in a rich broth, with melted cheese over toast.

    New on the board the same week the lunch menu launched: a smoked brisket and house pastrami Reuben.

    Lunch is where Edge started

    Lunch service launched in week two of the soft opening, while the team trained in live service. The menu above is the one the restaurant published itself, dish for dish.

    Come hungry.
    Leave happy.

    Edge Steaks and Seafood has no website and no Instagram. Everything runs through its Facebook page, which is also where hours, menu updates and the early bird and happy hour news are posted.
